# WordbitX

> WordbitX (WordbitX TECHNOLOGY SMC – PVT. LTD.) is a Pakistan-based software development company serving businesses in the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia and worldwide.

## What we do
- Custom websites and web apps
- Shopify, WooCommerce and custom e-commerce
- Flutter, Android and iOS apps
- POS, CRM/ERP and industry portals (healthcare, real estate, education, retail)
- SEO and digital marketing
- Practical AI in products where it helps the workflow

Clients own the code, repositories and accounts. Demos at *.wordbitx.pk are sample sites, not case studies.
